🤖 *SweetPea Admin Bot*
═══════════════════════

🔐 `/invite sweetpea` — Sweet Pea tier code (family/friends)
🌱 `/invite seedling` — Seedling tier code (manual override)

📋 `/pending` — Donors awaiting verification
✅ `/verify <id>` — Approve donor → generate code → email
❌ `/reject <id>` — Reject donor → email rejection

📊 `/status <username>` — Donor details
📧 `/resend <username>` — Reset password & resend
🚫 `/suspend <username>` — Disable access
🟢 `/unsuspend <username>` — Re-enable access

📜 `/list` — Active donors
👥 `/allsubs` — All donors
🔢 `/count` — Database dashboard

🔑 `/allcodes` — Every code
🟢 `/available` — Unused codes
🔴 `/usedcodes` — Redeemed codes
🔍 `/search <query>` — Find donor

🗑 `/delsub <user>` — Remove donor
🗑 `/delcode <code>` — Remove code
🗄 `/dbstatus` — Database health

🚨 `/incident <title>, <desc>` — Post an incident
✅ `/resolve <id>` — Resolve an incident

❓ `/help` — This menu
